deadline.value: No formal deadline (rolling, offers while funding lasts); international applicants strongly encouraged to apply by February 1 for internal scholarships. SGS: complete by January 31 for full scholarship consideration; considered until April 30.
deadline.quote: international applicants are strongly encouraged to submit their application materials by February 1st, in order to be considered for internal scholarships.

also.quote: Applications that are completed by January 31 are given full consideration for scholarships; applications are considered until April 30

gre_subject.value: No GRE requirement listed on the pages checked

supervisor.value: Funding includes a research fellowship from the supervisor's grant; contact faculty directly to ask if they are taking students
supervisor.quote: For interest in joining a specific research group, contact the faculty member directly and inquire if they are planning on taking on any new students.

funding.value: Full support guaranteed for all admitted students (scholarship + supervisor research scholarship + TA); minimum at least CAD 21,000 after tuition and fees
funding.quote: While full financial support is guaranteed for all admitted graduate students | The minimum guaranteed funding level after paying tuition and fees is at least $21, 000.

entry_route.value: The PhD expects a master's in physics, astronomy or a related area; students holding a bachelor's normally start in the MSc (thesis) and can move on to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Required Credentials Master's degree in Physics or Astronomy or a related area

notes: About 25 new MSc/PhD students per year; first offers often go out before Christmas, so earlier is better.
